message.militaryvehicles.controls: W/S: throttle, A/D: steering, Space: brake, %s: engine, %s: dismount. Chest + right-click: cargo.
message.militaryvehicles.invalid_state: Unsupported truck state. Original data retained; use is blocked.
message.militaryvehicles.park_first: Stop the truck and dismount everyone first.
message.militaryvehicles.inventory_full: Free one inventory slot for the truck.
message.militaryvehicles.no_space: Not enough room: allow roughly 6×6×4 blocks of clearance.
message.militaryvehicles.dry_ground: Place the truck on dry ground.
message.militaryvehicles.limit: The nearby truck limit has been reached.
message.militaryvehicles.placed: Truck placed. New trucks need fuel: can + right-click. Mount and start the engine (default G).
tooltip.militaryvehicles.truck: Right-click a block to place; sneak + right-click to pack with cargo.
tooltip.militaryvehicles.alpha: Alpha: wide collision box; in-game acceptance testing still required.
tooltip.militaryvehicles.can: Fuel: %s/%s. Right-click a truck without sneaking.
